'''Nakassk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] merchant who worked at [[Farnel Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Nakassk ran a small shop near the outpost's entrance, where he sold handgear, gloves, handwraps and gauntlets. The [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] spoke [[Selkath (language)|his species' native language]], had a mottled [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin color with light blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and wore a gray jacket, with pants and boots.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nakassk was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He was located inside the Command Center of [[Farnel Outpost]], near the entrance. His "Speciality Goods" included a ranged assortment of hand-armor for all playable classes.<ref name="TOR" />
